title: noContinuation acknowledgement is refused on native relay mailboxes while host guidance offers it for all mailboxes
outcome: noContinuation acknowledgement is refused on native relay mailboxes while host guidance offers it for all mailboxes
acceptance: Either a native relay mailbox acknowledgement accepts noContinuation with the same meaning as a local mailbox, or the host guidance and tool description state that relay mailboxes do not support it and what an agent should do instead; the two agree.
A focused check covers acknowledging a native relay mailbox receipt with and without noContinuation and matches the documented behaviour.
